title: Phoenix, AZ — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Phoenix, AZ: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Phoenix is a city in AZ with a population of 1,644,409. Valley of the Sun with 300+ days of sunshine, affordable housing, and rapid growth. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 9b growing zone supports Warm to hot — citrus, tropical fruits, year-round growing. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 299 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 34.8.
